en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographs of urban landmarks. The top image shows a modernist glass and concrete building with a jagged roofline, cars from the mid‑20th century parked in front, and historic church towers rising in the background. The bottom left image features a large city hall–type building with a prominent clock tower. The bottom right image shows an ornate Baroque courtyard façade with statues, balustrades and a richly decorated gate crowned by a large dome‑like crown; in front is a fountain basin.
